title: Faithfully flat modules and ring maps
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. An $R$-module $M$ is *faithfully flat* if for every complex $N_1\to N_2\to N_3$ of $R$-modules (composite zero), the complex is exact if and only if $M\otimes_RN_1\to M\otimes_RN_2\to M\otimes_RN_3$ is exact; in particular a faithfully flat module is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. A ring map $\varphi:R\to S$ of commutative rings is *faithfully flat* if $S$, an $R$-module via $\varphi$, is a faithfully flat $R$-module.
